summary: The PR adds a __len__ method to the Pipeline class, which resolves the issue of not being able to use len() on a Pipeline object. However, there are minor issues regarding documentation and test coverage.

issues.description: The added __len__ method does not have a docstring, which is a minor oversight.
While the tests pass, there are no specific tests added to verify the functionality of the new __len__ method. Adding a test case specifically for this would improve test coverage.
